paragraphs.source_en: At last, Ieyasu laughed heartily. When word spread that Ieyasu had arrived, the commanders gathered one after another to confer. Nobunaga had let him leave first because he knew some would object if they heard Ieyasu was to lead the vanguard.

units.source_en: At last, Ieyasu laughed heartily.
units.source_zh: 家康终于爽朗地笑了。

units.source_en: When word spread that Ieyasu had arrived, the commanders gathered one after another to confer.
units.source_zh: 得知家康抵达，武将们纷纷聚来议事。

units.source_en: Nobunaga had let him leave first because he knew some would object if they heard Ieyasu was to lead the vanguard.
units.source_zh: 听说让他去打头阵，定会有人不服，信长才让他先行离开。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康终于爽朗地笑了。得知家康抵达，武将们纷纷聚来议事。听说让他去打头阵，定会有人不服，信长才让他先行离开。

paragraphs.source_en: “Then I shall take up position at Nishi-Uezaka.” Ieyasu bowed and rose to his feet.

units.source_en: “Then I shall take up position at Nishi-Uezaka.”
units.source_zh: “那么，我去西上坂布阵。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu bowed and rose to his feet.
units.source_zh: 家康施了一礼，站起身。

paragraphs.source_zh: “那么，我去西上坂布阵。”家康施了一礼，站起身。

paragraphs.source_en: The summer cicadas shrilled with all their might. Carefully studying the surrounding terrain, Ieyasu descended Mount Tatsu鼻. He must always face Nobunaga openly and proudly, not trail cautiously behind him. He had to leave Nobunaga with one unmistakable impression—that he was a brave and dependable warrior… To that end, he must exert himself to the utmost in this battle and fully display the strength of the men of Okazaki; only then could he proclaim the existence of Tokugawa Ieyasu to all the realm.

units.source_en: The summer cicadas shrilled with all their might.
units.source_zh: 夏蝉拼命地鸣叫。

units.source_en: Carefully studying the surrounding terrain, Ieyasu descended Mount Tatsu鼻.
units.source_zh: 家康一边仔细观察周围的地形，一边走下龙鼻山。

units.source_en: He must always face Nobunaga openly and proudly, not trail cautiously behind him.

ja.t: くわけにはいかなかった。

units.source_zh: 他时刻都要堂堂正正地面对信长，而不是小心翼翼跟随其后。

units.source_en: He had to leave Nobunaga with one unmistakable impression—that he was a brave and dependable warrior… To that end, he must exert himself to the utmost in this battle and fully display the strength of the men of Okazaki; only then could he proclaim the existence of Tokugawa Ieyasu to all the realm.

ja.t: みつけねばならない……そのためには、この
らしめることができる。

units.source_zh: 必须给信长留下清晰的印象——他是一个勇猛可靠的武士……为了这一目的，他须在此战中竭尽全力，充分展示冈崎人的实力，才能向全天下宣告他德川家康的存在。

paragraphs.source_zh: 夏蝉拼命地鸣叫。家康一边仔细观察周围的地形，一边走下龙鼻山。他时刻都要堂堂正正地面对信长，而不是小心翼翼跟随其后。必须给信长留下清晰的印象——他是一个勇猛可靠的武士……为了这一目的，他须在此战中竭尽全力，充分展示冈崎人的实力，才能向全天下宣告他德川家康的存在。

paragraphs.source_en: His surmise was correct.

units.source_en: His surmise was correct.
units.source_zh: 他的猜测是正确的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他的猜测是正确的。

paragraphs.source_en: The next day, the twenty-eighth of the sixth month, the Asakura army reached Mita and faced the Mikawa army across the river. Their commander was Asakura Kagetaka.

units.source_en: The next day, the twenty-eighth of the sixth month, the Asakura army reached Mita and faced the Mikawa army across the river.
units.source_zh: 第二日，六月二十八，朝仓军来到三田，与三河军隔河相望。

units.source_en: Their commander was Asakura Kagetaka.
units.source_zh: 对方大将是朝仓景隆。

paragraphs.source_zh: 第二日，六月二十八，朝仓军来到三田，与三河军隔河相望。对方大将是朝仓景隆。

paragraphs.source_en: At Ieyasu’s request, Nobunaga redeployed his forces. Ieyasu would attack the Asakura army first, followed by Shibata Katsuie and Akechi Mitsuhide, with Inaba Ittetsu last; Sakai Ukon and Ikeda Nobuteru would attack the Azai army; Niwa Nagahide would stand ready to repel an assault from Yokoyama Castle; and Nobunaga himself, accompanied by Kinoshita Hideyoshi, Mori Sanzaemon, and his personal troops, would direct the battle from Higashi-Uezaka, to Ieyasu’s right.

units.source_en: At Ieyasu’s request, Nobunaga redeployed his forces.
units.source_zh: 根据家康的要求，信长作了重新部署。

units.source_en: Ieyasu would attack the Asakura army first, followed by Shibata Katsuie and Akechi Mitsuhide, with Inaba Ittetsu last;
units.source_zh: 先由家康向朝仓军发起攻击，随后是柴田胜家和明智光秀，最后是稻叶一铁；

units.source_en: Sakai Ukon and Ikeda Nobuteru would attack the Azai army;
units.source_zh: 而攻打浅井军的是坂井右近和池田信辉；

units.source_en: Niwa Nagahide would stand ready to repel an assault from Yokoyama Castle;
units.source_zh: 丹羽长秀则预备阻击来自横山城的袭击；

units.source_en: and Nobunaga himself, accompanied by Kinoshita Hideyoshi, Mori Sanzaemon, and his personal troops, would direct the battle from Higashi-Uezaka, to Ieyasu’s right.
units.source_zh: 信长自己带着木下秀吉、森三左卫门和亲信部队，在家康右方的东上坂地区坐镇指挥。

paragraphs.source_zh: 根据家康的要求，信长作了重新部署。先由家康向朝仓军发起攻击，随后是柴田胜家和明智光秀，最后是稻叶一铁；而攻打浅井军的是坂井右近和池田信辉；丹羽长秀则预备阻击来自横山城的袭击；信长自己带着木下秀吉、森三左卫门和亲信部队，在家康右方的东上坂地区坐镇指挥。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu smiled with satisfaction. Following his advice, Nobunaga’s formation was flawless, ready at any moment to crush whatever enemy came to provoke them. Having pacified the Kinai and amassed great power, Nobunaga would surely be mocked by Ieyasu if his battle array lacked splendor—Ieyasu understood his feelings perfectly.

units.source_en: Ieyasu smiled with satisfaction.
units.source_zh: 家康满意地笑了。

units.source_en: Following his advice, Nobunaga’s formation was flawless, ready at any moment to crush whatever enemy came to provoke them.
units.source_zh: 根据他的建议，信长此阵万无一失，随时都可将前来挑衅的敌军打个落花流水。

units.source_en: Having pacified the Kinai and amassed great power, Nobunaga would surely be mocked by Ieyasu if his battle array lacked splendor—Ieyasu understood his feelings perfectly.
units.source_zh: 信长已平定近畿，势力强大，若阵势不够豪华，势必会被家康嘲笑——家康很清楚他的心情。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康满意地笑了。根据他的建议，信长此阵万无一失，随时都可将前来挑衅的敌军打个落花流水。信长已平定近畿，势力强大，若阵势不够豪华，势必会被家康嘲笑——家康很清楚他的心情。

paragraphs.source_en: The third day, the twenty-ninth of the sixth month.

units.source_en: The third day, the twenty-ninth of the sixth month.
units.source_zh: 第三日，六月二十九。

paragraphs.source_zh: 第三日，六月二十九。

paragraphs.source_en: When the dawn mist dispersed northward, the Azai and Asakura armies crossed the Anegawa together and charged toward the main camps of Ieyasu and Nobunaga. The Asakura had more than eight thousand horsemen and intended to rout the five thousand spear-bearing Mikawa troops in a single stroke. When half the enemy force had crossed, the Mikawa troops advanced to meet them.

units.source_en: When the dawn mist dispersed northward, the Azai and Asakura armies crossed the Anegawa together and charged toward the main camps of Ieyasu and Nobunaga.
units.source_zh: 拂晓的雾向北散去后，浅井和朝仓的军队一起渡过姊川，向家康和信长的本阵冲杀过来。

units.source_en: The Asakura had more than eight thousand horsemen and intended to rout the five thousand spear-bearing Mikawa troops in a single stroke.
units.source_zh: 朝仓有八千余骑，想一举击溃手持长枪的五千三河军。

units.source_en: When half the enemy force had crossed, the Mikawa troops advanced to meet them.
units.source_zh: 待对方人马渡过一半，三河军迎了上去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 拂晓的雾向北散去后，浅井和朝仓的军队一起渡过姊川，向家康和信长的本阵冲杀过来。朝仓有八千余骑，想一举击溃手持长枪的五千三河军。待对方人马渡过一半，三河军迎了上去。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu stood on the riverbank with the sun at his back, staring intently at the battlefield. “This battle is our chance to show the realm the strength of Mikawa’s men. You must not give ground!” He had sternly commanded them before the battle. But when the two armies met at close quarters, the Mikawa force was swiftly split in two and driven back.

units.source_en: Ieyasu stood on the riverbank with the sun at his back, staring intently at the battlefield.
units.source_zh: 家康站在河滩上，背对太阳，紧紧盯着战场。

units.source_en: “This battle is our chance to show the realm the strength of Mikawa’s men.
units.source_zh: “这场战役是向天下展示三河人实力的机会。

units.source_en: You must not give ground!”
units.source_zh: 不得退缩！”

units.source_en: He had sternly commanded them before the battle.
units.source_zh: 他在战前严厉地命令道。

units.source_en: But when the two armies met at close quarters, the Mikawa force was swiftly split in two and driven back.
units.source_zh: 但当两军短兵相接时，三河军很快被切作两半，败退回来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康站在河滩上，背对太阳，紧紧盯着战场。“这场战役是向天下展示三河人实力的机会。不得退缩！”他在战前严厉地命令道。但当两军短兵相接时，三河军很快被切作两半，败退回来。

paragraphs.source_en: “I am Magara Jūrōzaemon Naotaka, the warrior of Konoha whose name is known throughout Echizen. I have come to pay my respects to Lord Ieyasu.” Brandishing a great sword, the man charged straight at them. The great sword measured a full five shaku and two sun and was ordinarily carried by four attendants.

units.source_en: “I am Magara Jūrōzaemon Naotaka, the warrior of Konoha whose name is known throughout Echizen. I have come to pay my respects to Lord Ieyasu.”
units.source_zh: “我乃越前无人不知的真柄十郎左卫门直隆，木叶的武士，前来拜会家康公。”

units.source_en: Brandishing a great sword, the man charged straight at them.
units.source_zh: 那人挥舞着大刀，直冲过来。

units.source_en: The great sword measured a full five shaku and two sun and was ordinarily carried by four attendants.
units.source_zh: 那把大刀足有五尺二寸长，平时总由四个侍从扛着。

paragraphs.source_zh: “我乃越前无人不知的真柄十郎左卫门直隆，木叶的武士，前来拜会家康公。”那人挥舞着大刀，直冲过来。那把大刀足有五尺二寸长，平时总由四个侍从扛着。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu felt his blood surge. The name “Magara of Echizen” was famed throughout the provinces, as was his great sword. Though he was already past fifty, the strength of his arms had not diminished in the least. Again and again his great sword hewed into the men of Mikawa, sending blood spraying through the morning haze like arcs of rainbow.

units.source_en: Ieyasu felt his blood surge.
units.source_zh: 家康顿觉热血上涌。

units.source_en: The name “Magara of Echizen” was famed throughout the provinces, as was his great sword.
units.source_zh: “越前真柄”的名字和他的大刀一起，名闻诸国。

units.source_en: Though he was already past fifty, the strength of his arms had not diminished in the least.
units.source_zh: 虽然其人年已五十出头，臂力却丝毫不减。

units.source_en: Again and again his great sword hewed into the men of Mikawa, sending blood spraying through the morning haze like arcs of rainbow.
units.source_zh: 他手中的大刀不时砍中三河人，鲜血在早晨的霞光中溅起，如同道道彩虹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康顿觉热血上涌。“越前真柄”的名字和他的大刀一起，名闻诸国。虽然其人年已五十出头，臂力却丝毫不减。他手中的大刀不时砍中三河人，鲜血在早晨的霞光中溅起，如同道道彩虹。

paragraphs.source_en: Overwhelmed by Magara’s ferocious advance, the Mikawa army began to retreat. The Asakura army’s confidence instantly soared. Their commander, Asakura Kagetaka, charged toward the river with a battle cry.

units.source_en: Overwhelmed by Magara’s ferocious advance, the Mikawa army began to retreat.
units.source_zh: 被真柄威猛的势头所逼，三河军开始撤退。

units.source_en: The Asakura army’s confidence instantly soared.
units.source_zh: 朝仓军顿时气焰嚣张。

units.source_en: Their commander, Asakura Kagetaka, charged toward the river with a battle cry.
units.source_zh: 大将朝仓景隆呐喊着向河边冲来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 被真柄威猛的势头所逼，三河军开始撤退。朝仓军顿时气焰嚣张。大将朝仓景隆呐喊着向河边冲来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Forward!” Ieyasu snapped the reins and advanced twenty or thirty paces in a fury. But men were already turning and fleeing; Ieyasu ground his teeth.

units.source_en: “Forward!”
units.source_zh: “向前！”

units.source_en: Ieyasu snapped the reins and advanced twenty or thirty paces in a fury.
units.source_zh: 家康猛地一抖缰绳，怒气冲冲地前进了二三十步。

units.source_en: But men were already turning and fleeing; Ieyasu ground his teeth.
units.source_zh: 但这时已经有人掉头往回跑了，家康的牙齿咬得咯咯响。

paragraphs.source_zh: “向前！”家康猛地一抖缰绳，怒气冲冲地前进了二三十步。但这时已经有人掉头往回跑了，家康的牙齿咬得咯咯响。

paragraphs.source_en: Boom! Boom! Musket fire suddenly rang out, but the shots missed Magara Naotaka and only made him fiercer.

units.source_en: Boom! Boom!
units.source_zh: 嗵嗵！

units.source_en: Musket fire suddenly rang out, but the shots missed Magara Naotaka and only made him fiercer.
units.source_zh: 突然传来火枪的声音，但没有射中真柄直隆，反而让他更加勇猛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 嗵嗵！突然传来火枪的声音，但没有射中真柄直隆，反而让他更加勇猛。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord!” Honda Heihachirō stared at Ieyasu.

units.source_en: “My lord!”
units.source_zh: “主公！”

units.source_en: Honda Heihachirō stared at Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 本多平八郎盯着家康。

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公！”本多平八郎盯着家康。

paragraphs.source_en: “Wait.” Ieyasu said. Rather than answering Heihachirō, he seemed to be rebuking himself, forcing himself to remain calm.

units.source_en: “Wait.”
units.source_zh: “等等。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu said.
units.source_zh: 家康道。

units.source_en: Rather than answering Heihachirō, he seemed to be rebuking himself, forcing himself to remain calm.

ja.t: めようとしたのである。

units.source_zh: 他与其说是在回答平八郎，不如说是在呵斥自己，让自己平静下来。

paragraphs.source_zh: “等等。”家康道。他与其说是在回答平八郎，不如说是在呵斥自己，让自己平静下来。

paragraphs.source_en: “If you retreat, my lord, all is lost!”

units.source_en: “If you retreat, my lord, all is lost!”
units.source_zh: “主公一旦撤退，就全盘皆输！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公一旦撤退，就全盘皆输！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Fool!” Beads of sweat formed on Ieyasu’s brow. He was waiting for the Oda troops on the right wing to drive into the Azai army. In battle, one had to press the attack in a single surge, raising the men’s spirit, overwhelming the enemy with momentum, and thereby seizing victory. Once the Oda army crossed the Anegawa, the enemy might turn its attention to the rear.

units.source_en: “Fool!”
units.source_zh: “浑蛋！”

units.source_en: Beads of sweat formed on Ieyasu’s brow.
units.source_zh: 家康额头上渗出了汗珠。

units.source_en: He was waiting for the Oda troops on the right wing to drive into the Azai army.
units.source_zh: 他在等待右翼的织田军杀进浅井军中。

units.source_en: In battle, one had to press the attack in a single surge, raising the men’s spirit, overwhelming the enemy with momentum, and thereby seizing victory.
units.source_zh: 打仗时应该一鼓作气，方能士气高涨，在气势上压过敌人，从而赢取胜利。

units.source_en: Once the Oda army crossed the Anegawa, the enemy might turn its attention to the rear.
units.source_zh: 只要织田军渡过姊川，敌人就可能将注意力转向后方。

paragraphs.source_zh: “浑蛋！”家康额头上渗出了汗珠。他在等待右翼的织田军杀进浅井军中。打仗时应该一鼓作气，方能士气高涨，在气势上压过敌人，从而赢取胜利。只要织田军渡过姊川，敌人就可能将注意力转向后方。

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, the Oda vanguard finally crossed the Anegawa.

units.source_en: At that moment, the Oda vanguard finally crossed the Anegawa.
units.source_zh: 此时，织田军的先锋终于渡过了姊川。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，织田军的先锋终于渡过了姊川。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not rush, my lord!” Just as Ieyasu was about to spur forward, Heihachirō leveled his spear, lashed his horse, and raced out.

units.source_en: “Do not rush, my lord!”
units.source_zh: “主公莫急！”

units.source_en: Just as Ieyasu was about to spur forward, Heihachirō leveled his spear, lashed his horse, and raced out.
units.source_zh: 家康正要跃马前去，平八郎挺枪拍马，飞奔出去。

paragraphs.source_zh: “主公莫急！”家康正要跃马前去，平八郎挺枪拍马，飞奔出去。

paragraphs.source_en: Heihachirō thrust his long spear toward the horse’s head. Magara’s mount reared violently, forcing him to rein it in at once.

units.source_en: Heihachirō thrust his long spear toward the horse’s head. Magara’s mount reared violently, forcing him to rein it in at once.
units.source_zh: 平八郎手中长枪直逼马首，真柄的马猛地跳起，迫得他赶紧勒住马头。

paragraphs.source_zh: 平八郎手中长枪直逼马首，真柄的马猛地跳起，迫得他赶紧勒住马头。

paragraphs.source_en: “Heihachirō, stand aside!”

units.source_en: “Heihachirō, stand aside!”
units.source_zh: “平八郎，让开！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “平八郎，让开！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Jūrōza, you stand aside!” Heihachirō shot back. “How dare you block my path, old man!”

units.source_en: “Jūrōza, you stand aside!”
units.source_zh: “十郎左，你闪开！”

units.source_en: Heihachirō shot back. “How dare you block my path, old man!”
units.source_zh: 平八郎回敬道，“竟敢挡我的道，老家伙！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “十郎左，你闪开！”平八郎回敬道，“竟敢挡我的道，老家伙！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Is that how a Mikawa whelp offers his greetings?”

units.source_en: “Is that how a Mikawa whelp offers his greetings?”
units.source_zh: “这就是你这三河小子的问候方式？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这就是你这三河小子的问候方式？”

paragraphs.source_en: The two men, their faces flushed crimson, looked at each other and grinned.

units.source_en: The two men, their faces flushed crimson, looked at each other and grinned.
units.source_zh: 两张涨得血红的脸相视而笑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 两张涨得血红的脸相视而笑。

paragraphs.source_en: “Come on, boy!”

units.source_en: “Come on, boy!”
units.source_zh: “来吧，小子！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “来吧，小子！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Come on, old man!”

units.source_en: “Come on, old man!”
units.source_zh: “来吧，老家伙！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “来吧，老家伙！”

paragraphs.source_en: Sword and spear clashed, and at last the Mikawa army halted its retreat.

units.source_en: Sword and spear clashed, and at last the Mikawa army halted its retreat.
units.source_zh: 一双刀枪杀在一起，三河军终于停止了撤退的脚步。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一双刀枪杀在一起，三河军终于停止了撤退的脚步。

paragraphs.source_en: The horns of both armies wailed above the riverbank.

units.source_en: The horns of both armies wailed above the riverbank.
units.source_zh: 双方的号角在河滩上空呜呜吹响。

paragraphs.source_zh: 双方的号角在河滩上空呜呜吹响。

paragraphs.source_en: Fearless, Honda Heihachirō leveled his spear, urged his horse on, and darted aside. If that great sword struck, both horse and rider would be torn beyond recognition. Heihachirō spotted an opening and thrust straight at him. Naotaka smiled coldly, slipped to the right, and immediately charged his horse forward.

units.source_en: Fearless, Honda Heihachirō leveled his spear, urged his horse on, and darted aside.
units.source_zh: 本多平八郎毫不畏惧，挺枪纵马，闪到一边。

units.source_en: If that great sword struck, both horse and rider would be torn beyond recognition.
units.source_zh: 若是被那大刀砍中，人马必死无全尸。

units.source_en: Heihachirō spotted an opening and thrust straight at him.
units.source_zh: 平八郎瞧准一个破绽，直刺过去。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not let them harm Heihachi, you cowards!” Ieyasu’s voice suddenly rang out. At that furious shout, the stalwart young warriors and Heihachirō’s retainers surged forward.

units.source_en: “Do not let them harm Heihachi, you cowards!”
units.source_zh: “不得伤了平八，你们这些胆小鬼！”

units.source_en: Ieyasu’s voice suddenly rang out.

units.source_en: At that furious shout, the stalwart young warriors and Heihachirō’s retainers surged forward.

paragraphs.source_zh: “不得伤了平八，你们这些胆小鬼！”这时，突然传来家康的声音。听到这声怒喝，精悍的年轻武士和平八郎的下属蜂拥过去。

paragraphs.source_en: Sakakibara Koheita, Katō Kisuke, and Amano Saburōbei rushed forward as one. Rather than rescuing Honda Heihachirō, they were forming a human wall before Ieyasu. Their fearless action instantly roused the men of Mikawa to counterattack.

units.source_en: Sakakibara Koheita, Katō Kisuke, and Amano Saburōbei rushed forward as one.
units.source_zh: 神原小平太、加藤喜介、天野三郎兵卫不约而同冲来。

units.source_en: Rather than rescuing Honda Heihachirō, they were forming a human wall before Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 与其说为了救本多平八郎，不如说是在家康面前组成一道人墙。

units.source_en: Their fearless action instantly roused the men of Mikawa to counterattack.
units.source_zh: 他们无畏的举动顿令三河人鼓起反击的勇气。

paragraphs.source_zh: 神原小平太、加藤喜介、天野三郎兵卫不约而同冲来。与其说为了救本多平八郎，不如说是在家康面前组成一道人墙。他们无畏的举动顿令三河人鼓起反击的勇气。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not fall back. Do not let the Oda men laugh at you.” Ieyasu shouted again. Encouraged by Ieyasu, Sakai Tadatsugu’s first division and Ogasawara Nagatada’s second charged the enemy and soon crossed the Anegawa.

units.source_en: “Do not fall back.
units.source_zh: “不要后退。

units.source_zh: 酒井忠次所率第一队和小笠原长忠的第二队在家康的鼓励下，向敌人冲过去，很快渡过姊川。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不要后退。不要被织田笑话。”家康又吆喝道。酒井忠次所率第一队和小笠原长忠的第二队在家康的鼓励下，向敌人冲过去，很快渡过姊川。

paragraphs.source_en: Honda Heihachirō wheeled his horse and charged Magara once more.

paragraphs.source_zh: “式部之弟五郎次郎来也。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Rokurōzaburō is here. We three brothers will take care of that great sword.”

units.source_en: “Very well. He is yours.”
units.source_zh: “好，那就交给你们。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “好，那就交给你们。”

paragraphs.source_en: Heihachirō had already achieved his purpose of rallying the troops. Leaving Magara Naotaka to the Kōsaka brothers, he wheeled his horse and plunged into the fighting ahead.

units.source_en: Heihachirō had already achieved his purpose of rallying the troops.
units.source_zh: 平八郎已经达到鼓舞士气的目的。

paragraphs.source_zh: 平八郎已经达到鼓舞士气的目的。他将真柄直隆让给向坂兄弟，拨马向前方冲杀过去。

paragraphs.source_en: At that very moment, the Oda army on the right suddenly fell into chaos. After killing Sakai Ukon Masahisa of the Oda clan and his son Kyūzō, Isono Kazumasa of the Azai first division swept onward with irresistible force and drove into Ikeda Nobuteru’s troops.

units.source_en: At that very moment, the Oda army on the right suddenly fell into chaos.
units.source_zh: 就在此时，右侧的织田军忽然大乱。

units.source_en: After killing Sakai Ukon Masahisa of the Oda clan and his son Kyūzō, Isono Kazumasa of the Azai first division swept onward with irresistible force and drove into Ikeda Nobuteru’s troops.
units.source_zh: 浅井家的第一队矶野员昌在杀了织田氏的坂井右近政尚和其子久藏后，如破竹之势，冲入池田信辉军中。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就在此时，右侧的织田军忽然大乱。浅井家的第一队矶野员昌在杀了织田氏的坂井右近政尚和其子久藏后，如破竹之势，冲入池田信辉军中。

paragraphs.source_en: The sun climbed steadily higher. The banks of the Anegawa were stained red with blood; blades flashed everywhere, while horns and war drums sounded without cease.

units.source_en: The sun climbed steadily higher.
units.source_zh: 太阳逐渐升高。

units.source_en: The banks of the Anegawa were stained red with blood; blades flashed everywhere, while horns and war drums sounded without cease.
units.source_zh: 姊川的河滩已被鲜血染红，处处刀光剑影，号角与战鼓响个不停。

paragraphs.source_zh: 太阳逐渐升高。姊川的河滩已被鲜血染红，处处刀光剑影，号角与战鼓响个不停。

paragraphs.source_en: Koheita led the household troops across the Anegawa like a gale.

units.source_en: Koheita led the household troops across the Anegawa like a gale.
units.source_zh: 小平太率领亲兵，疾风般渡过了姊川。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小平太率领亲兵，疾风般渡过了姊川。

paragraphs.source_en: The Asakura army was beginning to show signs of defeat, and at the very front only Magara Jūrōzaemon Naotaka remained, tightly encircled by the Kōsaka brothers.

units.source_en: The Asakura army was beginning to show signs of defeat, and at the very front only Magara Jūrōzaemon Naotaka remained, tightly encircled by the Kōsaka brothers.
units.source_zh: 朝仓军败迹渐露，最前线只剩下了被向坂兄弟死死围住的真柄十郎左卫门直隆一人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 朝仓军败迹渐露，最前线只剩下了被向坂兄弟死死围住的真柄十郎左卫门直隆一人。

paragraphs.source_en: Magara Naotaka’s strength was gradually failing. The Kōsaka brothers were deeply wary of Naotaka’s great sword. They circled him swiftly without launching an attack. But whenever Naotaka tried to withdraw, they advanced with spears leveled. Magara had realized his side was losing. Though the blazing sun had parched his throat like fire, he still refused to turn back; the moment he wheeled his horse, he would surely be mocked.

units.source_en: Magara Naotaka’s strength was gradually failing.
units.source_zh: 真柄直隆体力渐渐不支。

units.source_en: Magara had realized his side was losing. Though the blazing sun had parched his throat like fire, he still refused to turn back; the moment he wheeled his horse, he would surely be mocked.
units.source_zh: 真柄已发觉己方败势，虽然炎炎烈日令他喉咙干渴似火，他却依然不愿回去，一旦拨转马头，定会被嘲笑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 真柄直隆体力渐渐不支。向坂兄弟对直隆的大刀十分忌惮，围着他快速地转圈子，并不主动进攻。但当直隆要退却，他们又挺枪而上。真柄已发觉己方败势，虽然炎炎烈日令他喉咙干渴似火，他却依然不愿回去，一旦拨转马头，定会被嘲笑。

paragraphs.source_en: For Magara, who had swept all before him with a single great sword, the first principle of life was to be a true warrior, a true hero. As Magara raised his great sword high and reined in his horse, Sakakibara Koheita had already led the Mikawa men into the Asakura main camp on the strength of their momentum.

units.source_en: For Magara, who had swept all before him with a single great sword, the first principle of life was to be a true warrior, a true hero.
units.source_zh: 对于凭一把大刀所向披靡的真柄来说，人生的第一要义，就是做个真正的武士、真正的豪杰。

units.source_en: As Magara raised his great sword high and reined in his horse, Sakakibara Koheita had already led the Mikawa men into the Asakura main camp on the strength of their momentum.

paragraphs.source_zh: 对于凭一把大刀所向披靡的真柄来说，人生的第一要义，就是做个真正的武士、真正的豪杰。当真柄高高举起大刀，勒住马头时，神原小平太已经率领着三河人趁势冲进朝仓的本阵。

paragraphs.source_en: “Magara, why do you not strike?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah!” With a strange cry, Shikibu tumbled from his horse, and the long spear flew from his hands. Magara also leapt down from his horse.

With a strange cry, Shikibu tumbled from his horse, and the long spear flew from his hands.

paragraphs.source_en: “Gorō is here!” To save his elder brother from the blade, Gorōjirō intercepted Naotaka’s stroke. But how could his sword withstand Naotaka’s great blade? It was instantly cut in two, one piece flying into the treetop nearby.

paragraphs.source_en: “Ha, ha, ha…” Naotaka laughed. “You have bested me! Come and take my head. Hurry!” He flung away his great sword and collapsed heavily onto the scorching earth.
